# Tools CLI - AI Context & Project Documentation

> **System Prompt for AI Agents:** You are assisting with "Tools CLI," an interactive, high-fidelity developer dashboard. Use the context below to understand the architecture, routing, and technology stack before suggesting code changes or debugging.

## Project Meta
- **Application Name:** Tools CLI
- **Live URL:** https://tools-cli.konshu.in
- **Repository:** https://github.com/karan-k-code/tools-cli
- **Maintainer:** Karan Kumar (@karan-k-code)
- **Primary Goal:** To help developers master advanced command-line interface (CLI) engines through interactive generators, simulated terminals, and curated cheat sheets.

## Supported CLI Engines & Deep Links
AI Agents can use these routes to understand the scope of supported modules:
- `/` - [Dashboard Home](https://tools-cli.konshu.in): Main grid, bookmarks, and copy histories.
- `/about` - [About](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/about): Architecture and mission.
- `/git` - [Git Builder](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/git): Staging, branching, and commit configurator.
- `/gh` - [GitHub CLI](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/gh): Pull requests, issues, and repos.
- `/ollama` - [Ollama AI](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/ollama): Local LLM downloads and prompt builder.
- `/ffmpeg` - [FFmpeg Renderer](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/ffmpeg): A/V conversions and compression filters.
- `/yt-dlp` - [yt-dlp](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/yt-dlp): Media extraction script builder.
- `/python-pip` - [Python & Pip](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/python-pip): Venv manager and compiler setups.
- `/node-npm` - [Node & NPM](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/node-npm): Dependency and package setups.
- `/vercel` - [Vercel CLI](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/vercel): Server deployments and env bindings.
- `/gemini` - [Gemini CLI](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/gemini): API configs and parameters setup.
- `/adb` - [ADB Tools](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/adb): Android debugging commands.
- `/magick` - [ImageMagick](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/magick): Image manipulation scripts.
- `/fzf` - [Fuzzy Finder](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/fzf): Interactive shell searching pipelines.
- `/zoxide` - [Zoxide](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/zoxide): Smart directory navigation.
- `/ripgrep` - [Ripgrep](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/ripgrep): Blazing fast regex search.
- `/eza` - [eza](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/eza): Modern colorful file listing.
- `/bat` - [Bat](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/bat): Syntax-highlighted file viewing.
- `/lazygit` - [Lazygit](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/lazygit): Visual TUI for Git workflows.
- `/starship` - [Starship](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/starship): Cross-shell prompt configurations.
- `/utils` - [CLI Utilities](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/utils): Stream processors (jq, tmux, docker).
- `/quiz` - [Knowledge Quiz](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/quiz): Interactive terminal syntax test.

## Technology Stack & Architecture
- **Core:** React 19 + Vite (JavaScript SPA).
- **Routing:** React Router v7 (`BrowserRouter`). Converted from hash (`/#/tool`) to path-based routing (`/tool`) with `vercel.json` rewrites for production fallback.
- **Styling & UI:** Custom CSS variables (`index.css`), Lucide React (Icons).
- **SEO & Metadata:** Handled dynamically via a custom `useSEO` hook (`src/hooks/useSEO.js`) which updates HTML titles, meta descriptors, Open Graph tags, canonical URLs, and structured JSON-LD schemas.
- **Deployment:** Vercel (Static SPA).

## Codebase Tree Structure
```text
src/
├── App.jsx                 # Layout wrapper, routes declaration, and global state
├── App.css                 # Base container layouts
├── index.css               # Styling variables, color themes, and pulsing status dot
├── main.jsx                # App mounter wrapped with BrowserRouter
├── hooks/
│   └── useSEO.js           # Reusable custom SEO hook for metadata and JSON-LD
├── components/
│   ├── Sidebar.jsx         # Navigation sidebar and category filtering
│   ├── DashboardHome.jsx   # Grid of available tools, bookmarks, and histories
│   ├── ToolDetail.jsx      # Flowchart concept maps, interactive commands builder
│   ├── Console.jsx         # Mock terminal emulator screen
│   ├── Quiz.jsx            # Multi-choice interactive terminal quiz
│   ├── Footer.jsx          # Policy links and project credits
│   └── icons.jsx           # SVG wrappers for non-standard symbols (e.g., GithubIcon)
└── data/
    └── toolsData.js        # Single-source-of-truth for all CLI parameters and choices
